text:
Maya (Docs): Quick sync: preparing relnotes for next deploy (v1.1.0). Main items: snippet path cleanup, a couple of broken anchors discovered during link-check, and a streaming edge-case reported by QA. I'll open the PR in ~20m.

Jon (SDK): thanks — can you list the broken snippet refs so I can run a check against the snippets repo?

Maya (Docs): sure. Two I found: `snippet:embed_async_v3` referenced in guides/embeddings/overview.md and `snippet:chat_flow_step3` referenced from tutorials/llm-chat/flow.md (anchor moved). I'll add exact paths in the PR body.

Priya (I18N): heads up — localized branches (de/ja) still reference the old anchors. I can patch them but want the final anchor name before I rebase.

Jon (SDK): I can temporarily add stub snippets (marked TODO) to keep snippet-check passing while docs updates land. Will open a tiny PR.

QA-Bot: New issue filed by QA: #7782 — embed streaming sometimes emits an incomplete final token when max_tokens <= 7 on canary. Attached logs.

Ravi (Eng): confirmed. Root cause looks like partial-chunk flush ordering on the canary runtime. Fix is in progress but target is the next patch release.

Sam (Docs): For relnotes language, propose: "Known issue: embed streaming may omit the last token for very short prompts on canary models. Workaround: set max_tokens >= 8 or use stable models." Add repro steps so support can triage.

Maya (Docs): agree. I'll add a short repro snippet and a link to QA logs. Proposed snippet: 
```python
# examples/repro/embed_stream_short.py
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
print(c.embed_stream("tiny prompt", max_tokens=5))
```

Priya (I18N): let's create a single anchor on the english relnotes page `#known-issues-v1-1-0` and have localized pages link to it rather than duplicating. I'll update translations after merge.

Jon (SDK): opened PR #5567 with stub snippets and TODO comments. Marked them with TODO: replace-with-canonical.

Maya (Docs): PR by Maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5568 — title: "Relnotes v1.1.0: snippet tidy, link fixes, streaming note". Draft contains 3 bullets, example snippets, repro steps, and localization instructions.

QA-Bot: CI summary for PR #5568 — docs/lint: pass, snippet-check: fail (2 unresolved refs), link-check: fail (1 404).

Jon (SDK): merging my stub PR now to unblock checks.

QA-Bot: PR #5567 merged. Re-running checks on #5568: all checks now passing.

Ravi (Eng): if QA needs a short canary window to validate the repro, I can spin up a 30-minute canary in staging. Ping me.

Sam (Docs): add a one-line rollback playbook to the relnotes (contact: `#eng-oncall`) in case the streaming regression gets wider than expected.

Maya (Docs): added rollback steps and contact. Planning to merge relnotes tomorrow 09:00 PT and post the announcement after deploy.

Priya (I18N): will rebase localization fixes after merge and open i18n PR.

Jon (SDK): left a couple of tiny copy comments on the relnotes PR. :thumbsup:

Maya (Docs): merging in 10 unless objections.

Sam (Docs): no objections.

Ravi (Eng): good from engineering.

QA-Bot: PR #5568 merged. Maya posted announce draft to #product and scheduled newsletter blurb.

Maya (Docs): thanks all — closing thread. If follow-ups crop up, comment on the PR rather than reopening here. :tada:
